meta.title: Three bids: award a three-way split 4 / 3 / 3 to B, C and A; approver rejects
gaps: A closed RFQ with three bids from vendors A, B, and C at the specified prices is not available in the prepared state, which has only two bids.
Allocating 4 units to B, 3 to C, and 3 to A and verifying the resulting three-vendor totals cannot be performed without the third bid.
Signing in as the approver and rejecting the proposal with a remark cannot be performed by the catalog.
Verifying that no purchase order is created after rejection and that the buyer can restart awarding is not expressible.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ's Master QCS instead of creating or searching for an event.
Enable split awarding as required by the case.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Open the awarding screen for the prepared closed event.
Allocate four units to the second prepared bidder as the closest available part of the requested split.
Allocate the remaining six units to the first prepared bidder so the available two-bid event is fully allocated.
Verify the closest available two-vendor allocation is complete and totals 4×90 plus 6×100.
Create the award proposal from the completed available allocation.
Verify that the proposal page opened.
Fill mandatory proposal fields before submission.
Submit the proposal so the unavailable approver step would have a proposal to act on.
Verify that the submitted proposal is awaiting approval.
